reviewType: Independent read-only runtime/original-evidence contract design review; not implementation approval or whole-story QA
summary: The prospective original-question capture, immutable preparation-time acceptance witness and optional internal proof branch resolve the runtime provenance gap without executable/profile changes. Two exact frozen contract bounds must be corrected before implementation; no broader redesign is requested.

findings.finding: The frozen sentence calls the existing validation-request/basis bound8MiB. Existing basis is6,291,456 bytes while the whole request is8,388,608; conflating them silently weakens one receiving bound.
findings.requiredCorrection: State separate unchanged whole-composition ceilings: ValidationBasis6,291,456 UTF-8 bytes; complete ValidationRequest8,388,608. New witness/old-plan/question-observation bytes count inside these existing envelopes. No cap increase.
findings.regressionOracle: Independently exercise exact/over basis and request ceilings with choice witnesses, including UTF-8 multibyte expansion and many individually valid witnesses. A basis larger than6MiB refuses even inside an otherwise sub8MiB request.

findings.finding: ModelObservedQuestion advertises1..10 alternatives, but the original validated NEXT_ACTION.CLARIFICATION contract requires2..10. The local independent proof type must not accept a one-alternative response that production could not have admitted.
findings.requiredCorrection: Set the local ModelObservedQuestion choice cardinality to2..10; complete ordered server mapping/context joins then preserve that cardinality. Preserve generic/source context APIs and old provider schema unchanged.
findings.regressionOracle: A valid2-choice accepted alternate succeeds independently in Java/Node;0,1,11 alternatives and missing/extra/reordered/duplicate server mappings refuse even after local hashes are recomputed.

resolvedSourceFindings.decision: Satisfied by prospective capture, not reconstruction.
resolvedSourceFindings.source: GuidedTranslationService.question currently drops attemptIdentity; context.create stores no plan/owner association. Proposed internal capture carries actual reserved identity/projection facts and joins the original immutable plan. The original acknowledged observation is copied atomically before AWAITING_CLARIFICATION; V33 current-progress/hash guard is reusable. Missing older evidence refuses.

resolvedSourceFindings.decision: Satisfied by immutable preparation-time witness, with honest historical limits.
resolvedSourceFindings.source: clarify writes accepted_choice and mutable resolvedClarifications including resolvedAt. Receipt snapshots both under existing session/source transaction before effect and lives in an immutable V33 preparation row. No invented historical actor/acceptedAt/request body. Publication reader must match current accepted row plus immutable context/receipt and successful admission.

resolvedSourceFindings.decision: Satisfied by independently deriving only the selected target intent and exact locator.
resolvedSourceFindings.source: Java currently validates raw obligation; Node currently compares raw targetIntent. New branches keep raw plan/association meaning byte-equal, derive a local copy, require exact full locator equality, and retain all operation/predicate/input/need/binding/read/origin joins. Original question node and fresh prepared node are independently resolved; node IDs/documents need not survive refresh.

resolvedSourceFindings.decision: Satisfied by refusing multiple accepted questions even with equal locators and by actual-row completeness.
resolvedSourceFindings.source: Learning effectiveObligation currently iterates resolvedClarifications; deterministic rejection removes accidental order dependence. Java must find every accepted observed row and demand one successful immutable preparation witness. Node verifies supplied evidence but cannot discover omitted DB rows; design explicitly states that trust boundary.

resolvedSourceFindings.decision: Satisfied by the actual historical QuestionPlanEvidence and used-observation union.
resolvedSourceFindings.source: Original obligation must remain equal in historical and final immutable plans. Existing Node usedObservations equality covers only preparations; amendment expressly adds validated question references and still rejects unrelated observations. Existing400 count/1MiB pool remains authoritative.

resolvedSourceFindings.decision: Satisfied: new closed optional proof, omitted entirely for no/source-only choices; unchanged executable Profile and public/model/IPC bodies.
resolvedSourceFindings.source: Artifact Profile currently pins validationBasis1 and validator observed-1. The amendment changes evidence understanding without changing execution semantics. Exact new schemaBundleHash/build catalog fences old pure validators. Old already-published compatible artifacts remain executable through supported catalogs; missing old choice proof refuses new publication.

mandatoryImplementationConditions: Question capture must join the exact persisted CALLING request/attempt, locked original accepted plan, observedDocument execution evidence, actual reserved projection contextRevision/inputs hash and current materialization. After transaction commit the same attempt must be APPLIED/NEXT_ACTION/CLARIFICATION with the original safe_result. Do not search for a matching response after the fact.

Local question-data schema must preserve the actual NEXT_ACTION question reason enum (AMBIGUOUS_TARGET, AMBIGUOUS_BINDING, INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE), exact locator variants, Unicode/ID bounds and ordered meaning correspondence. Server IDs are separately generated; provider IDs/labels remain audit-only.

Treat original owner lease timestamp and resolvedAt as preserved historical data. Same worker/fence/context/source/config joins are required; ordinary acknowledged same-owner lease renewal does not require historical leaseExpiresAt to equal a later current lease or remain live at publication.

No accepted observed row may be dropped merely because the final target text matches the raw intent. Backend completeness must reject missing capture/receipt/action association for same-target and alternate-target choices. Node exact-locator comparison covers locator kind/role/name/value/exact, not just text.

After refresh require the later actual generation and independently verify the old and fresh observations. Never replay old node identity. Require original captured question observation and prepared execution origins/policy/scope to meet their corresponding exact joins; no wrong-origin or unapproved-policy fallback.

Keep original raw obligation and source/allocated plan untouched; referenceIndex/needId/bindingId/operation/predicate constraints remain exact. Selected meaning.bindingId is display/mapping provenance only, never an alternative producer, consumer edge, input value or read grant.

V33 receipt NULL is permitted only as absence of observed-choice provenance; accepted observed rows cannot be backfilled into prior preparations. Add strict closed SQL checks with IS TRUE and session/preparation identities; existing immutable-row trigger must protect the new column.

Apply witness262144-byte/200-count, receipt16384-byte, context64KiB/10 mappings, observation32768-byte/400-count/1MiB and corrected6MiB/8MiB composed bounds before expensive validation/transport. Preserved ISO instant bytes are not normalized to fabricate old hashes.

Build tooling must generate optional observedChoice property and exact local proof definitions into packaged schemas and TS types. Regenerate package schema hash/reference catalog as needed, negotiate exact build, preserve zero/source-only basis/artifact canonical bytes (deployment build identities may legitimately change).
No source/model/privacy/IPC/executable grammar change; no browser/model/account call in finalization or proof validation. No production account/live benchmark/pilot requirement is introduced.
requiredOracles: Independently hand-authored original-evidence positive fixture: actual accepted observed alternative differs from raw targetIntent, fresh node/generation differs after refresh, both Java and Node derive identical artifact and hashes. Validate positive baseline before mutations.

Hash-resealed mutations: absent/unaccepted/wrong question/choice; wrong original attempt/request/status/kind/model question; wrong historical plan/revision/hash/obligation; source/config/scope/worker/fence/context mismatch; missing/stale old observation; swapped old/fresh node/locator; same text but different locator kind/role; changed predicate/argument/read recipe/binding graph; unused/duplicate/superseded witnesses.

Atomic capture/acceptance tests and SQL missing/extra/null-key/cap/immutability tests; capture or source/owner drift rolls back question, observation, context and attempt application together. No network/model I/O inside those locks.

Prove zero/source-only canonical basis/artifact hashes unchanged; optional omission differs from explicit null and invalid extra fields. Existing historical receipts immutable; old validator/new witness and unsupported schema/catalog tuples refuse before browser. Compatible saved replay survives benign learning-default changes.

Cross-language canonical vectors with non-ASCII/combining/astral strings, null bindingId, original timestamp precision, optional omission, plan revision decimal strings near integer boundaries, and JSONB reorder/whitespace. No normalization or fabricated prompt/actor metadata.

Genuine observed-phase alternate question through actual public answer API, human/model delay greater than browser timeout, refresh, original action evidence, actual pure publication and two identical-artifact fresh private-value normal recorded replays. Independently assert chosen versus unchosen fields, one submission per explicit run, zero finalization actions, zero binding-read retries, and zero calls to both gateways during replay. Source-phase timing and async-result-only cases remain separate evidence.

ownership.decision: All identified production/test/schema/build seams are in173 proposed literal paths. Root must activate the3 new paths and schedule a later source/build window; this review does not do so.
